description: This file defines culture-specific date formatting and parsing utilities for the Northern Sotho (South Africa) locale in the DateJS library. It includes culture info such as month and day names, regex patterns for parsing date components, and extension methods for Date prototype to handle date calculations and formatting.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: An object containing localization information for the 'ns-ZA' culture, including names of days and months, date formats, regex patterns, and time zone data.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of the date object to zero (midnight).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: Date.today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object set to the start of the current day.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two date objects, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equivalent.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Gets the index of a day name, matching full, abbreviated, or shortest forms.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Gets the index of a month name, matching full or abbreviated forms.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month and year.
